claim_assessments.text: Your motorcycle was stolen from outside your house last night, constituting theft of a motor vehicle under the Pakistan Penal Code. You need to report the theft to the police and ensure proper investigation under the Criminal Procedure Code.
File an FIR (First Information Report) at the nearest police station immediately, describing the theft and providing any details (e.g., motorcycle make, model, registration number).
Insist that the police investigate under Section 156/157 as a cognizable offence and send the report to the appropriate magistrate.
Obtain a copy of the FIR and any subsequent investigation reports (including the report under Section 158).
Gather and preserve any evidence: photographs of the scene, CCTV footage, witness statements, and the motorcycle's registration documents.
Consult a criminal defence lawyer to advise on your rights, possible compensation, and to follow up on the investigation.

379. Punishment for theft: 
Whoever commits theft shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which 
may extend to three years, or with fine, or with both.
